scope: Development analysis of supplied 61-repository progress log plus paired classification of 56 fetched root READMEs. No independent test set. This is not a full v5.4 benchmark run. Reference labels never enter classifier matching.
code_interpretation: Cross-scope reference agreement only, not code-ground-truth accuracy
remaining_limitations: Root README evidence may omit information from other documentation or annotation-linked files.
No 80% or 90% F1 guarantee; existing always-positive baseline remains important.
Some reference distinctions are unresolved codebook questions, including publication/citation evidence.
Serialized Wolfram notebook boxes are not reconstructed; affected code scans are incomplete.
Minified/source-map and named corpus exclusions are methodological proxies, not proof of third-party status.
